"""Independent evidence checks: pixel-only decisions, crop identity, fixed baseline,
unchanged inference/parser artifacts, and independently recounted coordinates.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,importlib.util,subprocess
import cv2,numpy as np
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;FT=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-finetune-20261015';V3=FT/'paired-v3'
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
manifest=read(ROOT/'gap-inputs.json');rule=read(ROOT/'rule-v1.json');report=read(ROOT/'report.json')
assert manifest['ruleSHA256']==report['ruleSHA256']==sha(ROOT/'rule-v1.json')
assert len(manifest['inputs'])==346
sources={x['id']:x for x in read(V3/'replay-inputs.json')['inputs']}
for item in manifest['inputs']:
    assert not {'expected','state','text','selected'}&set(item)
    assert item['sourceROISHA256']==sources[item['id']]['cropSHA256']==sha(Path(item['sourceROI']))
    im=cv2.imread(item['original']['tophat']['image'],0)
    # Independently build runs with a loop rather than the preparation np.diff.
    ink=(im[5:39]>200).sum(0);runs=[];start=None
    for i,n in enumerate(list(ink)+[999]):
        if n<=2 and start is None:start=i
        if n>2 and start is not None:
            if 150<=start<=460 and 24<=i-start<=64:runs.append((start,i,i-start))
            start=None
    runs.sort(key=lambda r:(-r[2],r[0]))
    cut=None if not runs or len(runs)>1 and runs[0][2]-runs[1][2]<8 else runs[0][0]+8
    assert cut==item['decision']['cut']
    for variant in ['contrast','tophat','raw']:
        original=Path(item['original'][variant]['image']);prepared=Path(item['images'][variant])
        assert sha(original)==item['original'][variant]['sha256']
        assert sha(prepared)==item['preparedSHA256'][variant]
        full=cv2.imread(str(original));actual=cv2.imread(str(prepared))
        expected=full if cut is None else np.pad(full[:,:cut],((0,0),(0,4),(0,0)))
        assert np.array_equal(actual,expected)
cached=read(FT/'coverage-v2/replay-coverage-positive.json');fresh=read(ROOT/'baseline-v2.json')
baseline_checks=0
for mode,items in cached['pipelines'].items():
    current={r['id']:r for r in fresh['pipelines'][mode]}
    for old in items:
        if old['id'] not in current:continue
        new=current[old['id']]
        assert old['rawText']==new['rawText'] and old['selected']==new['selected']
        assert abs(old['modelScore']-new['modelScore'])<1e-6
        baseline_checks+=1
assert baseline_checks==319*8
model_checks={}
for model,path in [('v2',FT/'coverage-v2/replay-coverage-positive-provenance.json'),('v3-routes',V3/'replay-pair-routes-provenance.json')]:
    provenance=read(path);directory=Path(provenance['modelDirectory'])
    for name in ['inference.json','inference.pdiparams','inference.yml','ppocr_keys.txt']:
        value=sha(directory/name);assert value==provenance['sha256']['ppocr/'+name]
        model_checks[model+'/'+name]=value
    assert sha(SOURCE/'out/build/coordinate-offline/IMaoCoordinateOffline.exe')==provenance['sha256']['nativeExecutable']
    assert sha(SOURCE/'IMao-Core/paddleocr_cpp_infer/lib/ppocr.lib')==provenance['sha256']['ppocrLibrary']
    assert read(ROOT/f'gap-{model}.json')['baseFingerprint']==fresh['metadata']['compiledSHA256']
truth={f['id']:f for path in ['development-corpus.json','training-pair-corpus.json'] for f in read(V3/path)['frames']}
scene={r['id']:r['sceneGroup'] for r in read(V3/'paired-manifest.json')['rows']}
trained={f['id'] for f in read(V3/'training-pair-corpus.json')['frames']}
sources_by_model={'v2':{'full':fresh,'gap':read(ROOT/'gap-v2.json')},'v3-routes':{'full':read(V3/'replay-pair-routes.json'),'gap':read(ROOT/'gap-v3-routes.json')}}
checks=0
for row in report['summary']:
    items=sources_by_model[row['model']][row['condition']]['pipelines'][row['mode']]
    values=[]
    for p in items:
        fid=p['id'].split('@')[0];f=truth[fid];g=row['group']
        member=fid in trained if g=='trained-fit-only' else fid not in trained if g=='all-development' else fid not in trained and 776<=int(fid[-6:])<=787 if g=='heldout-stationary-776-787' else fid not in trained and scene.get(fid)==g
        if member:values.append((f,p))
    assert len(values)==row['frames']
    for metric in ['correct','wrong','miss','falsePositive','trueNegative','unknownReturned','unknownNoReturn']:
        count=0
        for f,p in values:
            s=p['selected'];known=f['state']=='present';good=known and s is not None and [s[k] for k in 'xyz']==[f['expected'][k] for k in 'xyz']
            hit={'correct':good,'wrong':known and s is not None and not good,'miss':known and s is None,
                 'falsePositive':f['state']=='absent' and s is not None,'trueNegative':f['state']=='absent' and s is None,
                 'unknownReturned':f['state']=='unknown' and s is not None,'unknownNoReturn':f['state']=='unknown' and s is None}[metric]
            count+=bool(hit)
        assert count==row[metric],(metric,row,count)
    checks+=len(values)
for path in report['sourceEvidence']:
    for kind in ['baseline','gap']:assert sha(Path(path[kind]))==path[kind+'SHA256']
tracked=['IMao-Core/src/Coordinate','IMao-Core/tools/CoordinateOffline','IMao-Core/paddleocr_cpp_infer']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--',*tracked],cwd=SOURCE,text=True)
v={'pixelDecisionsIndependentlyRecomputed':346,'variantPixelChecks':346*3,'oldBaselineExactMatches':baseline_checks,'summaryRowJudgmentsRecounted':checks,
   'productionPathsUnchangedAgainstHEAD':True,'ruleSHA256':sha(ROOT/'rule-v1.json'),'reportSHA256':sha(ROOT/'report.json'),
   'executableSHA256':sha(ROOT/'build/CoordinateGapProbe.exe'),'sourceSHA256':sha(ROOT/'patch_replay.cpp'),'modelsMatchPriorProvenance':model_checks}
(ROOT/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
print(v)

support_probe.py.text:
"""Post-hoc, separate policy counterfactual. Never changes the spatial rule.
No truth, corpus, minimap, temporal position or labels are read here.
Preserve full-view returns; fill misses only with a parsed crop supported
by an anchored, non-glued, complete XYZ from the full-view raw text.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,copy
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;FT=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-finetune-20261015';V3=FT/'paired-v3'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
pattern=re.compile(r'^\s*([+-]?\d+)\s*,\s*([+-]?\d+)\s*,\s*([+-]?\d+)(?=\s|$|[+-]\d{4}-)')
out=ROOT/'support-results.json'
if out.exists():raise RuntimeError('Preserve previous policy counterfactual')
reports=[]
for model,basepath,gappath in [('v2',ROOT/'baseline-v2.json',ROOT/'gap-v2.json'),('v3-routes',V3/'replay-pair-routes.json',ROOT/'gap-v3-routes.json')]:
    base=read(basepath)['pipelines']['ppocr-contrast-clock']
    crop={x['id']:x for x in read(gappath)['pipelines']['ppocr-contrast-clock']}
    results=[]
    for original in base:
        patched=crop[original['id']];row=copy.deepcopy(original);selected=patched['selected']
        match=pattern.match(original['rawText']);xyz=tuple(map(int,match.groups())) if match else None
        agrees=selected is not None and xyz==tuple(selected[k] for k in 'xyz') and original['modelScore']>=.65
        fill=original['selected'] is None and agrees
        if fill:row['selected']=copy.deepcopy(selected);row['candidates']=copy.deepcopy(patched['candidates'])
        row['supportProbe']={'fullViewTriple':xyz,'cropSelected':selected,'fullAndCropXYZAgree':agrees,'filledMissingReturn':fill,'policy':'preserve full returns; support cropped XYZ in both geometry views; no label-based choice'}
        results.append(row)
    reports.append({'model':model,'results':results})
out.write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Separate post-hoc counterfactual after observing v1 crop failures. Development already explored, not independent validation. No parser or spatial rule modified.','reports':reports},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Supported additions',[(r['model'],sum(x['supportProbe']['filledMissingReturn'] for x in r['results'])) for r in reports])

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
from collections import Counter
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;FT=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-finetune-20261015';V3=FT/'paired-v3'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
truth={f['id']:f for name in ['development-corpus.json','training-pair-corpus.json'] for f in read(V3/name)['frames']}
train={f['id'] for f in read(V3/'training-pair-corpus.json')['frames']}
scenes={r['id']:r['sceneGroup'] for r in read(V3/'paired-manifest.json')['rows']}
prepared={x['id']:x for x in read(ROOT/'gap-inputs.json')['inputs']}
def integer(s):
    t=s.strip();digits=t[1:] if t[:1] in ['+','-'] else t
    return int(t) if digits and all('0'<=c<='9' for c in digits) else None
def prefix(text):
    parts=text.lstrip().split(',',2)
    if len(parts)!=3:return None
    x,y=integer(parts[0]),integer(parts[1]);ztext=parts[2].lstrip();end=int(ztext[:1] in ['+','-'])
    while end<len(ztext) and '0'<=ztext[end]<='9':end+=1
    z=integer(ztext[:end]);tail=ztext[end:]
    boundary=not tail or tail[:1].isspace() or len(tail)>=6 and tail[0] in '+-' and tail[1:5].isdigit() and tail[5]=='-'
    return (x,y,z) if x is not None and y is not None and z is not None and boundary else None
supported=read(ROOT/'support-results.json');scored=read(ROOT/'support-report.json')
unchanged_fallback=0;policy_checked=0
for report in supported['reports']:
    model=report['model'];base=read(ROOT/'baseline-v2.json' if model=='v2' else V3/'replay-pair-routes.json')['pipelines'];gap=read(ROOT/f'gap-{model}.json')['pipelines']
    baseline={x['id']:x for x in base['ppocr-contrast-clock']};cropped={x['id']:x for x in gap['ppocr-contrast-clock']}
    for mode,rows in gap.items():
        originals={r['id']:r for r in base[mode]}
        for row in rows:
            if prepared[row['id']]['decision']['cut'] is None:
                assert row['rawText']==originals[row['id']]['rawText'] and row['selected']==originals[row['id']]['selected']
                unchanged_fallback+=1
    for row in report['results']:
        full=baseline[row['id']];crop=cropped[row['id']];xyz=prefix(full['rawText']);selected=crop['selected']
        agree=selected is not None and xyz==tuple(selected[k] for k in 'xyz') and full['modelScore']>=.65
        filled=full['selected'] is None and agree
        assert row['supportProbe']['filledMissingReturn']==filled
        assert row['supportProbe']['fullAndCropXYZAgree']==agree
        assert row['supportProbe']['fullViewTriple']==(list(xyz) if xyz is not None else None)
        assert row['selected']==(selected if filled else full['selected'])
        policy_checked+=1
    for summary in [s for s in scored['summary'] if s['model']==model]:
        counts=Counter()
        for row in report['results']:
            fid=row['id'].split('@')[0];g=summary['group']
            belongs=fid in train if g=='trained-fit-only' else fid not in train if g=='all-development' else fid not in train and 776<=int(fid[-6:])<=787 if g=='heldout-stationary-776-787' else fid not in train and scenes.get(fid)==g
            if not belongs:continue
            f=truth[fid];s=row['selected'];counts['frames']+=1;counts['newSupportedReturn']+=row['supportProbe']['filledMissingReturn']
            if f['state']=='present':counts['miss' if s is None else 'correct' if all(s[k]==f['expected'][k] for k in 'xyz') else 'wrong']+=1
            elif f['state']=='absent':counts['trueNegative' if s is None else 'falsePositive']+=1
            else:counts['unknownNoReturn' if s is None else 'unknownReturned']+=1
        assert all(counts[k]==v for k,v in summary.items() if k not in ['model','group'])
    fid='session-1F638949-A4DA-46C7-8131-3F08EEFD62FD-001072@readout-line'
    assert cropped[fid]['selected']['z']==55 and baseline[fid]['selected'] is None
    assert next(r for r in report['results'] if r['id']==fid)['selected'] is None
assert unchanged_fallback==139*4*2 and policy_checked==346*2
historical=read(ROOT/'historical/report.json')['rows'];assert len(historical)==11
assert sum(r['supportOutcome']=='correct' for r in historical)==5
assert sum(r['supportOutcome']=='trueNegative' for r in historical)==4
assert next(r for r in historical if r['id']=='user-grass')['supportOutcome']=='wrong'
assert next(r for r in historical if r['id']=='user-snow')['state']=='unknown'
assert all(r['support']['selected']==r['full']['selected'] for r in historical)
result={'fallbackDirectReplayExactMatches':unchanged_fallback,'supportPoliciesIndependentlyChecked':policy_checked,'historicalCases':11,'fiveHistoricalXYZAndFourNegativeRetained':True,'oldGrassStillWrong':True,'oldSnowStillUnknown':True,'newTruncation1072BlockedInSupportProbe':True,
    'artifactSHA256':{f:sha(ROOT/f) for f in ['rule-v1.json','gap-inputs.json','report.json','support-results.json','support-report.json','verification.json','historical/report.json']}}
(ROOT/'support-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(result)

"""Frozen-rule regression on the 11 existing historical cases, not new acceptance."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os,importlib.util,re,copy,hashlib
import cv2
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;FT=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-finetune-20261015';V2=FT/'coverage-v2'
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS');DATA=ROOT.parent.parent
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
write=lambda p,v:p.write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
corpus=read(V2/'historical-evaluation-corpus.json');truth={f['id']:f for f in corpus['frames']}
items=[x for x in read(V2/'historical-coverage-positive/inputs.json')['inputs'] if x['sourceId'] in truth and x['profile']=='readout-line']
assert len(items)==11
out=ROOT/'historical';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
if (out/'report.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('Preserve historical report')
write(out/'inputs.json',{'inputs':items})
env=dict(os.environ);env['PATH']=str(DATA/'x64/Release')+os.pathsep+env['PATH']
model=V2/'coverage-positive-infer-paddle30'
native=SOURCE/'out/build/coordinate-offline/IMaoCoordinateOffline.exe'
result=subprocess.run([str(native),str(model),str(out/'inputs.json'),str(out/'full.json'),'1','aspect',str(out/'native-preprocessed')],env=env,capture_output=True)
(out/'full.log').write_bytes(result.stdout+result.stderr);assert result.returncode==0
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gap_prepare',ROOT/'prepare.py');module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
prepared=[];(out/'patches').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for item in items:
    ident=item['id'];decision=module.locate(cv2.imread(str(out/'native-preprocessed'/f'{ident}.tophat.png'),0));images={}
    for variant in ['contrast','tophat','raw']:
        path=out/'native-preprocessed'/f'{ident}.{variant}.png'
        if decision['cut'] is not None:
            im=cv2.imread(str(path));patch=cv2.copyMakeBorder(im[:,:decision['cut']],0,0,0,4,cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,value=(0,0,0))
            path=out/'patches'/f'{ident}.{variant}.png';assert cv2.imwrite(str(path),patch)
        images[variant]=str(path)
    prepared.append({'id':ident,'images':images,'decision':decision})
write(out/'gap-inputs.json',{'inputs':prepared,'ruleSHA256':sha(ROOT/'rule-v1.json')})
result=subprocess.run([str(ROOT/'build/CoordinateGapProbe.exe'),str(model),str(out/'gap-inputs.json'),str(out/'gap.json')],env=env,capture_output=True)
(out/'gap.log').write_bytes(result.stdout+result.stderr);assert result.returncode==0
baseline=read(out/'full.json');gap=read(out/'gap.json');original=read(V2/'historical-coverage-positive/ppocr.json')
for mode,rows in baseline['pipelines'].items():
    cache={r['id']:r for r in original['pipelines'][mode]}
    for row in rows:assert row['rawText']==cache[row['id']]['rawText'] and row['selected']==cache[row['id']]['selected']
pattern=re.compile(r'^\s*([+-]?\d+)\s*,\s*([+-]?\d+)\s*,\s*([+-]?\d+)(?=\s|$|[+-]\d{4}-)')
gaps={r['id']:r for r in gap['pipelines']['ppocr-contrast-clock']};supported=[]
for full in baseline['pipelines']['ppocr-contrast-clock']:
    candidate=gaps[full['id']]['selected'];match=pattern.match(full['rawText']);xyz=tuple(map(int,match.groups())) if match else None
    row=copy.deepcopy(full);fill=full['selected'] is None and candidate is not None and full['modelScore']>=.65 and xyz==tuple(candidate[k] for k in 'xyz')
    if fill:row['selected']=copy.deepcopy(candidate)
    row['filledMissingReturn']=fill;supported.append(row)
def outcome(f,s):
    if f['state']=='absent':return 'falsePositive' if s else 'trueNegative'
    if f['state']=='unknown':return 'unknownReturned' if s else 'unknownNoReturn'
    if s is None:return 'miss'
    return 'correct' if all(s[k]==v for k,v in f['expected'].items() if v is not None) else 'wrong'
rows=[]
for ident,f in truth.items():
    fid=ident+'@readout-line';full=next(r for r in baseline['pipelines']['ppocr-contrast-clock'] if r['id']==fid);crop=gaps[fid];support=next(r for r in supported if r['id']==fid)
    rows.append({'id':ident,'state':f['state'],'expected':f['expected'],'fullOutcome':outcome(f,full['selected']),'cropOutcome':outcome(f,crop['selected']),'supportOutcome':outcome(f,support['selected']),
       'full':full,'crop':crop,'support':support,'decision':next(r['decision'] for r in prepared if r['id']==fid)})
write(out/'report.json',{'scope':'11 prior historical regressions, excluding six historical training frames. XY-only and unknown retained. Not independent acceptance.','rows':rows})
for row in rows:print(row['id'],row['fullOutcome'],row['cropOutcome'],row['supportOutcome'],'cut',row['decision']['cut'])
